label: preparing
what: A coordinated gathering at the town hall for day 1 at eighteen, with eight installed lanterns and 200 fresh loaves (24 delivered, 75 from innkeeper, 101 through freight). Builder has accepted the 101-emerald credit debt. Its purpose has not been disclosed to me; a celebration of my forty years of service is plausible but remains speculation. Secretary knowingly helps coordinate and clarify arrangements and payment, without authorizing town spending.
